description.purpose: Scheduled fetch-and-forward: a timer fires daily, a web_fetch pulls a URL, a code cell formats the result, a Telegram proxy delivers it to a fixed chat. Since 2.1.0 both behaviour knobs are PARAMS of `./clock` rather than substitution tokens out of the colony's environment ([#138](https://github.com/mmeyerlein/meclaw/issues/138), ruling R-0904-6): they live inside `params.schedules`, the one key that holds the whole list, so an `override_params` entry names `schedules` and replaces it, and `contract.settings` declares what each field means. Since 2.1.1 the silent terminal `./void` runs `warm` rather than `cold` ([#852](https://github.com/mmeyerlein/meclaw/issues/852)): it swallows every inbound chat of the bot, keeps no state and reads its stdin as text only, so a fresh namespace per message is all it needs; nothing a caller sees moves, which is why it is the third digit. Since 2.2.0 ([#976](https://github.com/mmeyerlein/meclaw/issues/976)) the digest keeps what it showed with its round and time on a shelf the member's presenter reads on `in_read`. A caller can rely on what was never promised before, so it is the second digit. Since 2.2.1 ([#801](https://github.com/mmeyerlein/meclaw/issues/801)) the Telegram sender takes its bot token as a sealed vault grant (`bot_token_grant_id`) instead of `TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN`. Where a key comes from is a repair of the promise, so it is the third digit.Since 2.2.2 ([#1085](https://github.com/mmeyerlein/meclaw/issues/1085)) `./format` sends the page text whole up to the carrier's ceiling -- the 4096 characters of one Telegram message, less the heading -- and a longer one ends in the mark with its total, instead of 3500 characters and `[truncated]`; nothing a caller sends moved, so it is the third digit.
description.use_when: Periodic push of one URL's content to one Telegram chat. Override the URL, the cron expression and the chat id at instantiation. A parent may also demand a run at the hive path on lane in_digest, bringing context.chat_id itself, and take the formatted digest back on lane digest.
description.not_in_scope: No multi-source aggregation, no LLM summarization (insert an llm cell between format and notifier for that), no per-user subscriptions.
